text.tspan: Share of population with alcohol use disorder vs. drug use disorder 2023
Share of the population with an alcohol use disorder versus the share with drug use disorder (which does not
include alcohol or tobacco smoking). Drug use disorders include opioids, cocaine, amphetamine and cannabis.
